notes_for_editor: Two sources: the TN Landforms list and Wikipedia for the county seat. The list's codes show where its coordinates came from (GFC-provided, BLL) and an older GFC list (gfc), but neither says what stood on the site, when, or whether anything survives. The name 'millen' is the compiler's label (entry 178 is above 73) and is lowercase on the list; a human may want to decide how to show it. Two searches found no GFC or Jenkins County record of a tower here. The cached NHLR Georgia index is truncated and was not used. Status and access stay unknown. A GFC records request would be the best next check.
